title: Candidate Verifier v1.4 Semantic Intervention Paired Development Protocol

governanceConsequence.unpausePolicy: Governance does not unpause even if all development gates pass.

estimand.definition: The incremental semantic effect of Candidate Verifier v1.4 source-boundary instructions relative to v1.3 instructions, conditional on Gemini 3.8 Flash operating with thinkingLevel=low.
estimand.thinkingLevelBaseline: Low thinking is a fixed engineering baseline. This study does NOT estimate the independent effect of thinking level.

controlledVariables.semanticRequestDelta: v1.3 prompt bytes vs v1.4 prompt bytes. Arm A_PRIME uses byte-identical prompt/request construction to Arm A.

cohortSpecification.p1SelectionNotice: P1 freezes the protocol, prompt, firewall, and lint only. Candidates are not yet selected or inspected.

methodologicalLimitations.bundledIntervention: v1.4 is evaluated as one bundled semantic prompt intervention. The study cannot identify which individual rule caused any later improvement or degradation. No component-level causal claim is permitted. A future focused ablation may be separately preregistered.
methodologicalLimitations.thinkingLevelInteraction: Results apply only to v1.4 under thinkingLevel=low. Failure of v1.4-low would not prove that the semantic principles are universally ineffective. Prompt x thinking-level interaction is outside this study.
methodologicalLimitations.balancedCohortPrevalenceCaveat: The 30/30 class balance is constructed. Sensitivity and specificity are legitimate development operating characteristics. PPV, NPV, review burden, positive-call rate, and all prevalence-dependent quantities must be marked CONSTRUCTED_COHORT_DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY and cannot be interpreted as production prevalence estimates.

repeatabilityControl.technicalInvalidAccounting: Technical-invalid outputs are reported separately and cannot be converted into semantic LOW or HIGH. Semantic agreement is evaluated only where both outputs are valid.

layerA.title: VALID_PAIRED_SEMANTICS
layerA.scope: Evaluated exclusively on records where BOTH Arm A and Arm B produced valid semantic outputs.
layerA.invalidHandling: Technical-invalid outcomes are NEVER semantic TPs.

defectPositiveTransitions.rescue: Arm A LOW -> Arm B HIGH
defectPositiveTransitions.regression: Arm A HIGH -> Arm B LOW
defectPositiveTransitions.persistentDetection: Arm A HIGH -> Arm B HIGH
defectPositiveTransitions.persistentEscape: Arm A LOW -> Arm B LOW

cleanTransitions.introducedFalsePositive: Arm A LOW -> Arm B HIGH
cleanTransitions.repairedFalsePositive: Arm A HIGH -> Arm B LOW
cleanTransitions.persistentClean: Arm A LOW -> Arm B LOW
cleanTransitions.persistentFalsePositive: Arm A HIGH -> Arm B HIGH

layerB.title: ALL_RECORD_FAIL_CLOSED_ROUTING
layerB.scope: Evaluates full operational routing where all technical-invalid outcomes route to human review.
layerB.inflationProhibition: Layer B must never be used to inflate semantic sensitivity.

technicalCompletenessGate.governancePrinciple: A/B technical completeness governs semantic treatment comparison, and A/A_PRIME technical completeness governs repeatability interpretation.

defectPositiveComparison.alternative: v1.4 produces more rescues than regressions (rescues > regressions)
defectPositiveComparison.confidenceIntervalMethod: 95% Wilson score confidence intervals for sensitivity

cleanComparison.confidenceIntervalMethod: 95% Wilson score confidence intervals for specificity
cleanComparison.equivalenceCaveat: Do NOT treat failure to reject a significance test as proof of specificity equivalence.

gateG_SevereSafety.policyNote: Any severe escape blocks automatic advancement and requires case review. This is a DEVELOPMENT SAFETY POLICY, not statistical proof of zero population risk.

schedulePermutations.enforcementNote: P2/P3 schedule construction must satisfy these exact counts. P1 freezes the quota but does not construct the schedule.

providerExecutionControl.modelVersionChangeRule: If provider model version changes mid-run, execution halts immediately with INCONCLUSIVE_PROVIDER_MODEL_MUTATION.
providerExecutionControl.versionDriftMitigation: Near-contemporaneous triplet interleaving within short execution window minimizes provider version drift.

cohortFirewall.reconciliationPolicy: No candidate may become evaluation-eligible until P2 reconciles all prior manually inspected/test/development candidate IDs into a complete exclusion ledger.
